title: Trader
description: Definition of Trader under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019

content.legal_definition: a person who sells or distributes any goods for sale and includes the manufacturer thereof, and where such goods are sold or distributed in package form, includes the packer thereof
content.plain_language: a person or company that sells or gives out goods to others, including the maker of the goods and the person who packages them
examples: a company that manufactures and sells electronics
a store that buys and resells packaged food products
non_examples: a person who only buys goods for personal use
a company that only provides services, not goods
